title: Book One · Chapter 27: Tell Them
story:
Miss Wu gives Ronan a few minutes before the morning lesson.

He stands beside his desk. He doesn't want the front of the room. Miss Wu asks him to speak clearly. He can stay beside his desk.

Leo moves his chair so Ronan has room. Jun sits with his hands under his legs.

"The extra kites won't be ready," Ronan says.

"We know," someone says.

Miss Wu lifts one hand. The room quiets.

"I said yes to the kites. But I did not finish them. Then some paper got wet. I didn't tell people at once."

He stops. The next words are on the small note in his hand, but he cannot find the line.

Leo points to the middle. He says nothing.

"I kept saying tomorrow. That made you wait. I'm sorry."

Jun looks at the floor. "Did you spend the coin?" another child asks.

"My mum has it. We're returning it."

Miss Wu says Mum will talk to Jun's mother. They will check the money together. The class does not need to do that.

"Any question about the display?" she asks.

Jun lifts his hand. "Can my windmill be on the same table?"

"Yes. Bring it tomorrow so we can check the space."

Ronan sits down. He puts the note away. His hands shake a little. No one claps. Miss Wu opens the reading book, and the day begins.

At break, the same boy comes to the window desk. He made the joke about broken wood earlier.

"Did the rain really ruin it?"

"Some of it."

"Then why didn't you just say that?"

Ronan looks out at the dry yard.

"Because it wasn't only that."

The boy shrugs and goes to play. He does not ask anything else. Ronan puts his hands on the desk. He can stop explaining for a while.

Mei comes to borrow a brown pencil from Leo. She sees Ronan's note sticking out of his book.

"Can I see?"

He gives it to her. She reads the first part.

"You can say the words, then cross them off."

"Why?"

"Then you can stop looking at them."

Ronan takes his pencil. He doesn't cross the whole note out. At the bottom, Mum has written RETURN COIN. He still needs to do that.

After school, he and Mum go to Jun's home. Ronan wants to talk at the doorway again. Jun's mother invites them in this time, but only for a few minutes. Dinner is cooking.

Jun shows his windmill. The four sides are green. One is smaller than the others, so it turns with a little jump.

"It's better when you blow here," he says.

Ronan blows too hard. The little wheel turns backward and stops.

Jun laughs. Then he looks at Ronan and covers his mouth. Is Ronan upset?

Ronan laughs too. "Mine falls without any help."

Mum takes out the folded material packet. She asks Ronan to check the note with her. The coin is still in the packet. It never went into his tea box. The packet is plain and small between their hands.

Jun calls his mother to the table. Ronan waits with the packet in his hand. He has told Jun he is sorry. Now he has to return the coin. He checks the note with Mum once more.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：because＝因为；cross off＝划掉；return＝归还；coin＝硬币。

理解问题：

1. Ronan 怎样向班里说明真正原因？
2. 为什么他没有把全部责任归给雨？
